explanation: The pole detects the lexical field of inherited culture: it fires on culture/cultural, heritage, tradition(s)/traditional, history/historic, the stems ' pat' (patrimony, patina), ' archae'/'olog'/'ologie' (archaeology), 'lore' (folklore) and 'picturesque', including the cognates that share these tokens in other languages (patrimonio, tradicion, Tradition, 'وطني', 'قدس'). It is keyed to those word forms rather than to the heritage topic - a bare mention of the word 'culture' still fires (1.2) and so does ' pat' in patita or patrolling (2.7 and 2.2 in the scan) - while passages that carry the heritage idea in other words (museum, monument, artifact, ancient, medieval, festival, crafts, cuisine, architecture, 'songs and stories handed down') and the laboratory senses of ' culture' (cell culture, yogurt culture) stay below the active threshold; the same neuron's positive pole instead rises on shopping/product text (2.8 on a '$9.99' game blurb versus 0.1 on the culture sentences).
